results.title: J&K Congress mourns demise of Senior Office Secretary Muhammad Saleem
results.description: The Jammu and Kashmir Congress on Wednesday condoled the demise of its senior office-bearer and Office Secretary, Muhammad Saleem, describing him as a dedicated party worker whose contributions would be remembered. In a condolence message, the party said Saleem was a kind, humble and noble-hearted person whose sincerity, dedication and commitment to the Congress and the people earned him respect across the organisation, as per KNS. The Congress leaders said his sudden demise had deeply saddened party leaders and workers and created a void that would be difficult to fill. Expressing solidarity with the bereaved family, the party prayed for eternal peace to the departed soul and strength and patience for his family, friends and all those who knew him. The party also prayed that Almighty Allah forgives his shortcomings and grants him the highest place in Jannat-ul-Firdous. Meanwhile, PCC President Tariq Hameed Karra, AICC General Secretary & CLP Leader GA Mir besides a number of senior Congress leaders attended the last rites of Mohammed Saleem Khan. Karra termed his death a great loss to the party HQ ,as he was an important bridge of communication with the party cadres. He shared the grief of the bereaved family members and prayed for peace to the departed soul. AICC General Secretary and CLP Leader G A Mir has deeply condoled the sad demise of Saleem and described his untimely demise a great loss to the Congress family and his own family. He described him as an asset to the party. He prayed for peace to the departed soul and shared the grief of the bereaved family. Former Minister and Ex PCC President Peerzada Mohammed Sayeed MLA has also deeply condoled the untimely demise. Prof Soz condoles demise Former Union Minister, Prof Saifuddin Soz has expressed grief over the passing away of Muhammad Saleem Khan of the Congress Party, saying the untimely demise was quite shocking. “His absence will mean a vacuum in the Congress Party Office at Maulana Azad Road, Srinagar. He was a person who always had a smile on his face. He served the Congress party with dedication,” saif Prof Soz. “Saleem Khan’s demise is a great loss to the J&K Congress Party. I offer my condolences to the bereaved family. May God rest his soul in peace and give fortitude to the bereaved family to bear this irreparable loss,” he added.
